customer: We're cutting back to one car and I need to sell our minivan, but every time I try to figure out your process I end up more confused. Do I have to buy something from Northwind just to sell it to you, and what actually happens? I'm in Texas and don't have time to waste on this.
agent: Sorry for the confusion. Selling your minivan takes four steps, and you don't have to buy a car from us to sell one. First, get an offer online with your VIN or license plate, or walk into any store for a quote on the spot. Then book an appraisal appointment, where a specialist inspects the minivan in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer, and finally you sign the paperwork and get paid. Offers last a limited time, so check "How long is my offer good for?" in our "Selling your car to Northwind: how it works" article.
